scenario: Irregular breath during conflict with professor in front of class
student_samples: My grades are going to tank, I just know it. This placement season is already so messed up and I just had a huge fight with Professor Patel in front of the whole class. My heart is racing like crazy, what if he doesn't give me a placement now?
It's not just the placement, it's my whole GPA... everything. I'm gonna fail, I know I'll fail. What if I don't make it to the top companies now, what if I get stuck in some low-tier firm?

scenario: Legs feeling heavy and mind foggy in afternoon lectures
student_samples: Ugh, I'm so done with today's lectures. My legs feel like lead and my mind's foggy - I can barely focus on anything the prof's saying. I swear, this post-lunch dip is killing me, especially with mid-terms around the corner and placements looming.

I'm just trying to scribble down some notes, but my hand keeps shaking and I'm pretty sure I've written down gibberish. I was going to sneak out to get some fresh air, but now that you mention it, I guess I could try taking a quick power nap in the library instead, hoping it doesn't get me kicked out. My friends have been telling me to just drink more water and eat something, but it's hard to even think about food right now.

scenario: Breath hold exercises triggering panic instead of calm
student_samples: What's going on? I was just trying to meditate, relax before mid-semester exams, and I had to learn some pranayama exercises for wellness club. But now I'm freaking out - I held my breath for like seconds and suddenly my heart is racing, and I feel like I'm choking...
No... I don't think I can. What if my heart stops or something? I remember my cousin had this episode where their heart stopped when they tried to learn CPR...

scenario: Comparing body with gym-going hostel roommates and feeling inadequate
student_samples: Ugh, I'm just so fed up with this. I've been feeling terrible about my body lately. Seeing everyone in my hostel, especially those gym enthusiasts, always motivates them to hit the gym early in the morning and look so toned...

Honestly, I've just been trying to sleep in, skip classes, and avoid seeing anyone, but that's not gonna get me through mid-terms or placements. And it's not like anything brings me comfort - I've been scrolling through Instagram too much, comparing my life to these seemingly perfect gym-goers...

scenario: Heart palpitations during panic attacks that feel like cardiac events
student_samples: I'm freaking out, I just got back to my hostel room and I'm having these insane heart palpitations. I thought I was having a heart attack, like, for real, it was that bad - rapid heartbeat, dizziness, the whole nine yards. What if this is some weird side effect of anxiety and I'm actually sick?

Scary is an understatement - I've never felt like this before, it feels like my heart is literally going to stop. Every panic attack is different, but this one feels way more intense than usual - it's like my brain is short-circuiting or something. What if I pass out in the middle of mid-sem exams?

scenario: Energy crash after long online classes sitting motionless
student_samples: I just had my mid-semester placements and I'm totally drained. Sitting in front of this laptop for hours feels like I've been stuck in some kind of digital purgatory. Every muscle in my body aches and I just wanna go back to bed.

I don't even know what I need at this point... All I want is to get out of this hostel room, go for a walk, get some fresh air... Anything to get my blood flowing, you know? But even thinking about leaving seems like too much right now.

scenario: Feeling wiped out from maintaining a happy facade all day
student_samples: I'm so done. Mid-sems are coming and I'm freaking out. How am I gonna keep up these grades when I'm barely making it to my lectures?
Every single thing is just piling up. Placements, mid-terms, hostel mess... I feel like I'm drowning. My GPA is already on the line, I don't even know if I can pass this semester.

scenario: Eating alone every day causing sadness around mealtimes
student_samples: Ugh, I don't know how much more of this I can take. Eating alone every day in the mess hall is killing me. It's so depressing, I'm trying to get a good GPA for placements, but the thought of sitting by myself in that crowded room is just too much.

Yeah, it's not just the mess hall, it's the entire hostel culture here. Everyone seems to have their own group, making friends and stuff. I'm starting to feel like an outcast, like I'm just going to be stuck eating alone every meal for the next two years. Maybe if I can find someone to sit with, someone who's also in the same situation?

scenario: Knee injury stopping all sports causing emotional withdrawal
student_samples: Ugh, my knee... it kills me. I was meant to play for the varsity football team this mid-semester placement, and now I'm stuck in the hostel, unable to even walk without wincing in pain. What if I never get my position back?

No, I'm scared to go see a doctor... what if they say I'm done for the year, or worse, that I'll never be able to play again? I've been trying to avoid thinking about it, hoping it'll magically heal itself. What if my GPA suffers because of this?

scenario: Falling asleep in lectures due to chronic sleep debt
student_samples: I'm literally falling asleep in lectures. Can't seem to focus on anything, my GPA is going to tank because of this sleep debt I've accumulated. It's not like I'm not trying, I've tried to study earlier, but my brain just shuts down and I zone out.

No, I haven't been taking care of myself at all. I'm always stuck in the library, cramming for mid-semester exams or working on group projects. And it's not like I have a nice hostel room to retreat to, our dorm is basically a noise factory, and I've been sleeping with earplugs for weeks.

scenario: Oversleeping due to depression and missing morning classes
student_samples: Ugh, I don't know how this keeps happening to me. I overslept again, and now I've missed my 8am psychology lecture. My mid-semester exams are approaching, and I'm already behind in placements. How am I supposed to catch up now?

I guess that's true... it's all just feeling so heavy right now. I wish I could shake off this depression and just be motivated again. I've missed a bunch of lectures and now I'm seriously worried about my GPA slipping.

scenario: Nightmares about failing exams disrupting sleep quality
student_samples: .. I'm so frazzled. I just had the worst nightmare - I was sitting in the exam hall, blanking on my circuit analysis MCQs, and my professor was yelling at me in front of everyone. Now I'm wide awake and it's only 2 am, I have a placement interview in 5 days, and I'm still behind on my project...

Honestly, with mid-sem exams coming up, it's been tough to maintain a balance. I've been pulling all-nighters, trying to catch up on my notes, and barely fitting in meals. Sometimes, I try to listen to calming music or go for a run to clear my head, but it's hard to shake off this feeling of being on the verge of a nervous breakdown. And now, this nightmare's made me question everything...

scenario: Holding breath unconsciously while reading difficult problems
student_samples: Ugh, I'm so done with engineering. We just got mid-sem results and I'm barely passing thermodynamics. I've been studying for 12 hours straight, but nothing's making sense.

I've just been stuck here in the library, staring at these problems and trying to solve them. I went back to the hostel for a bit, but my roomie's been bugging me to hang out and I don't even feel like talking. I've just been eating pizza and energy drinks, and I'm starting to crash now but my brain's still racing.

scenario: Back pain from sitting 14 hours a day coding
student_samples: Ugh, it's like, I've been coding for 14 hours straight and my back is killing me. I've got a placement interview coming up and I really don't want to mess it up, but every time I sit here, I feel like I'm stuck in this perpetual cycle of pain. I've been trying to take breaks, but somehow I always end up back at this computer in my hostel room.

Honestly, I'm just so scared of messing up. My GPA's already not great, and if I don't get a decent placement, my parents are going to be all over me. And, yeah, taking care of myself, like, I'm supposed to be, but every time I get a break, I just end up scrolling through social media or watching videos. It feels like I'm just procrastinating even more.

scenario: Feeling physically drained after conflict with parents

scenario: Feeling suffocated in closed seminar rooms during long lectures
student_samples: Ugh, I'm literally dying in here. This seminar room is so suffocating - it's like a tiny box with no air. I'm on edge just thinking about our placement presentations coming up, and now this cramped space is making my anxiety spike even more.

I'm just thinking about all the other assignments piling up, and our mid-sem exams are just around the corner. I'm pretty sure I've got decent group dynamics for the presentation, but what if we mess up? What if I freeze up in front of the class?

scenario: Feeling paralyzed and unable to get out of bed in the morning
student_samples: I don't know how much more of this I can take, I've got mid-sems coming up and I'm so far behind on my research, I'm literally freaking out. scenario: Recurring stomach aches with no clear medical cause

And on top of all that, my stomach's been killing me all weekend, I've been eating the same things, same routine, but it's like my body just decided to shut down on me.

scenario: Shortness of breath climbing stairs due to anxiety not fitness

scenario: Feeling frozen and unable to move during panic attacks

Plus, every time I try to focus, I start feeling anxious and my mouth breathing gets worse.

scenario: Prana drain from constantly being 'the responsible one' in the group

All this pressure is piling up and I just feel like I'm not doing well enough, you know?

scenario: Gym anxiety because more experienced peers judge form

I feel like I'm stuck in the past, where I was struggling to lift 20 pounds, and now I'm still not there, but everyone else seems to be. I'm always worried I'll get kicked out for having poor form or looking like a total newbie.

scenario: Can only sleep 3-4 hours during placement season

scenario: Restless leg sensation preventing sleep; leg energy not settling
student_samples: Ugh, I'm so frustrated. I've been lying awake in my hostel room for hours, and my leg is literally itching to get up and walk around. I had a huge placement interview this morning, and I think I messed it up...

I don't know...all I want to do is sleep but nothing's working. Every time I try to settle down, my leg just starts tingling again, like it's screaming at me to get up. My GPA is on the line for this semester, and if I don't get a good placement, I'll be so far behind my peers...

scenario: Feeling lightheaded after trying Kapalabhati on YouTube
student_samples: I'm totally freaking out, I was trying to learn Kapalabhati breathing exercises on YouTube and now I feel super lightheaded, it's like a wave of nausea is crushing me. My mid-sem exams are around the corner and I still have to study for those, I don't have time for this.

The fact that I'm feeling this miserable after only a few minutes of trying this stupid exercise is super frustrating.

scenario: Irregular sleep cycle shifting by 4+ hours every week

Break? Are you kidding me? I've got group projects due, and our profs keep sending emails about placements, like I haven't got anything else to worry about... My brain's mush, I just keep going to sleep at weird hours now, four hours ahead of my normal schedule, it's like my body's just given up.

scenario: Dreading waking up every morning without a clear reason
student_samples: I don't wanna wake up. What's the point, anyway? My mid-sem exams are coming up and I still haven't studied for them in like, weeks.
No, I don't do anything. I just lie in bed and stare at the ceiling. I hate waking up to the sound of the hostel's announcements. It's just a reminder that I have to get up and study.

scenario: Sweating excessively in social settings causing embarrassment
student_samples: Ugh, I'm so freaking out right now. I was in the library and then I had to go to this group placement meeting for our mid-sem project, and I started sweating like crazy. I couldn't even stop myself, and I'm worried they're all thinking I'm some kind of weirdo.

I just want to crawl under a rock and hide.

student_samples: I just got out of my placement interview and I completely messed it up. The panel asked me like, three impossible questions and I couldn't answer any of them. My mind is racing, thinking about all the what-ifs. What if I don't get placed and have to go back home and embarrass my parents? What if my friends who did better than me get placed and I'm stuck here in the hostel with nothing to do? I can barely think straight, my hands are shaking like this...

scenario: Panic breathing pattern developing during online exam proctoring

scenario: Feeling like running on empty after 3 all-nighters in a row

scenario: Physical exhaustion from managing part-time job and academics

I'm falling behind on my coursework and I just know I'll get kicked out of my placement if I don't turn things around. What if I fail this year? scenario: Breathing fast and shallow when reading exam results online

scenario: Feeling energetically drained after a group project meeting
student_samples: Ugh, I'm spent. That group project meeting just killed me. We were supposed to finalize all the details and it went on for hours, I swear.

scenario: Too tired to exercise even though it usually helps

My GPA is gonna tank, and I'll never get a job... my parents will be so disappointed...

*looks down, fidgeting with hands* It's... it's just this fatigue, okay? It's been going on for so long, ever since COVID... I can barely get out of bed in time for classes, and when I do, I'm so exhausted all the time. The thought of going to a 9 am lecture is just... *shakes head*...

scenario: Avoiding swimming pool sessions because of body shame
student_samples: Ugh, I'm so frustrated with myself. I've been avoiding the hostel's swimming pool sessions for weeks now, and my friends keep asking me why I'm not coming. I feel like such a loser for not being able to handle the thought of swimming in front of them, but honestly, I just can't shake off the feeling of insecurity every time I see myself in the mirror - especially my mid-sem break, I'm really worried about it affecting my GPA.

I haven't talked to my friends about this yet, but it's hard for me to open up about how I'm really feeling. They'll just say stuff like "you're fine, you're great" and try to make me feel normal, but it's not the same. As for taking care of myself, I've been trying to study and focus on my courses, but it's hard when I'm constantly worried about my body image; I've been having trouble sleeping, and my usual routine of meditation and yoga hasn't been helping lately.

scenario: Burst of energy then complete crash in a daily cycle
student_samples: Ugh, I'm at my wit's end. Mid-semester exams are just around the corner, and I haven't even started studying for them. My placements are going great, but I'm barely managing a 7.5 GPA, and my hostel's been bugging me about my messiness.

That sounds like empty words, sorry. I know I need to prioritize, but have you seen the depth of problems I'm facing? I have four subjects, and I've barely touched my notes. My exams are going to destroy my GPA, and my placements...they're counting on me for this research project.

scenario: Waking up with panic at 3 AM multiple nights in a row
student_samples: I don't know what's wrong with me. I keep waking up at 3 AM, my heart's racing, and I just can't breathe. I need to get up, but I'm scared 'cause I'm in bed and I have a placement test coming up in a week and I'm so unprepared...

My entire grade's riding on this test. What if I fail? I'll lose my chance at a good internship and then my GPA will tank. I'll never get a grad placement, and I'll have to stick around for another year...

scenario: Severe migraine attacks triggered by screen time during assignments
student_samples: Oh god, I'm having another one of these killer migraines. I've been staring at my laptop screen for hours trying to finish this assignment for our placements. It's like, I know I need to get a good GPA to impress the companies, but my head is literally on fire.

No, I haven't, I've been too afraid I'll fall behind, and I know mid-sems are coming up, and what if I fail this placement? I've already been behind schedule with my coursework because of the holidays and now this. My head is pounding and I can feel tears pricking at the corners of my eyes.

scenario: Dizzy spells when standing up suddenly after long study sessions
student_samples: *sighs heavily* I don't know what's going on with my body anymore. I've been getting these super annoying dizzy spells every time I stand up after studying for hours in the library or in my hostel room. My placements are just a few semesters away and I really need to pull up my GPA, but this is freaking me out.

*shakes head* Honestly, I've been trying to just push through it, but it's getting harder. When I stand up, my vision blurs and I feel like I'm about to pass out. I've told my hostel's infirmary, and they said I should see a doctor, but I don't know if it's a big deal or just something I need to get used to...

scenario: Yawning constantly in class despite caffeine intake
student_samples: I'm so done with today, I swear. I've been yawning nonstop in class and my notes are literally just a bunch of scribbles because I zoned out. My midterm is in two weeks and I'm still stuck on thermodynamics, it's killing me.

Honestly, I haven't really been prioritizing my sleep lately, trying to cram in studying on top of placements prep, and it's caught up to me. I guess I need to schedule out some time for a decent nap or two and try to establish a more normal routine or something.

scenario: Irregular heartbeat sensation noticed during stressful periods
student_samples: Oh god, I'm freaking out. I was studying for my mid-semester exams and suddenly I felt this weird irregular heartbeat, it's been happening a lot lately. What if I pass out during the placement season or something?

I...I've been trying to brush it off, thinking it's just stress or lack of sleep, but it's been happening more often than I can handle. I don't know if I should go see the college doctor or just hope it goes away. What if they think I'm not cut out for engineering or something?

scenario: Loud construction noise near hostel disrupting focus daily
student_samples: Ugh, this is ridiculous. I'm trying to study for my mid-sem exams and I'm being completely distracted by all this construction noise near the hostel. It's been going on for weeks and I'm barely making progress.

Honestly, I was thinking of just heading to the library, but I don't know if it's any better there. The noise is basically deafening all the time, and I'm starting to feel like I'm going to get a headache or something. I just want to be able to focus on my notes without wanting to scream.

scenario: No enthusiasm for any subject despite choosing the stream voluntarily
student_samples: I don't know how I've made it this far. Engineering has lost all meaning to me now. My grades are slipping, GPA's in danger, and placements are getting scarier by the day.

Every company that comes here is just looking for coding skills and I'm like, totally overwhelmed with the amount of coursework and mid-semester exams... placements are getting tougher and tougher. It's like, all I hear is, "You gotta bag a good placement, or else you're nothing". I try to brush it off, but it's always there, nagging me.

scenario: Feeling buzzy and wired after caffeinated study sessions
student_samples: I'm freaking out, man. I just had a marathon study session and those two cups of coffee are killing me. My brain is buzzing nonstop, I keep thinking I've got a million things to do and I'm going to fail all my placements.

Ugh, you have no idea. I've been pulling all-nighters for weeks now and my hostel's study room is always packed. I'm so anxious about my mid-semester grades and the whole GPA thing is stressing me out. I just feel like I'm drowning in assignments and exams.

scenario: Crowded canteen triggering physical discomfort and shutdown
student_samples: I need to get out of here, it's too much. This canteen is killing me, all these people, the noise, the smell. I can feel my panic rising, I don't know if I can handle mid-semester exams like this.

Every sound is like a knife to my nerves, my heart is racing, and I just want to escape. I can feel my skin crawling, like someone's touching me all over. What if I have a meltdown in front of everyone?

scenario: Joy returning briefly after a good conversation then disappearing
student_samples: Ugh, I'm literally so done with everything right now. Just got out of a placement interview and I'm pretty sure I bombed it. My GPA's already on edge, and I really need a good placement to secure my future...

Every conversation I'm having with professors or potential employers keeps replaying in my head, and I'm convinced I said something stupid that sealed my fate. Mid-semester exams are around the corner too, and I'm barely managing to keep up with all my lectures, let alone the coursework. Haven't really been taking care of myself, to be honest - just trying to survive till the end of the sem.

scenario: Feeling too thin and being mocked by peers in the hostel
student_samples: I'm freaking out right now, I just got out of my room in the hostel and some guys are making fun of how skinny I look. I know I'm an ectomorph, but it's just getting to me, all these mocks about being too thin.

It's just... my stomach's all knotted up and I feel like I'm going to be sick, my heart's racing and I just wanna get out of here. I need some space, but I don't want to go back to my room, that's where it all started...

scenario: Stress eating and hating oneself afterward in a shame cycle
student_samples: Ugh, I'm such a mess. I just binged on a whole pizza by myself, and I hate myself for it. How am I even going to survive till placement season when I'm this much of a failure?
No, no, it's not that simple. I just keep thinking about all the exams coming up and how I'm never going to get good enough grades to get a decent placement. My art project is due soon and I'm stuck.

scenario: Cafeteria food causing digestive issues and avoiding eating there
student_samples: Ugh, I'm so done with the hostel food, you know? It's like they're trying to kill us with all this unhealthy stuff. Since the mid-sems, my stomach's been acting up every time I eat here, and I just can't take it anymore.

Yeah, I've talked to my friends about it, but they just tell me to eat yogurt or something. I don't know, it's not like that's a real solution. And yeah, I went to the hostel's counselor once, but they just gave me some generic advice and told me to "eat healthy."

scenario: Hostel noise making it impossible to fall asleep before 2 AM
student_samples: Ugh, I'm so done with this hostel. I've been trying to sleep since 12 AM, but all I can hear is the loud music coming from the room next door. I have a placement interview tomorrow and I really need to get a good night's sleep, but it's impossible with all this noise.

scenario: Skipping meals for 2-3 days straight during exam week
student_samples: Oh my god, I'm totally screwed. I know I shouldn't be skipping meals, but I just haven't had time for anything except studying for this mid-sem exam in mecheng. My GPA is on the line, I really need to get these placements sorted, and if I bomb this exam, it's gonna be disastrous.

Ugh, it's just all or nothing, you know? If I don't get this exam, I'll never get into a decent company for placements, and my life will be over. I'll be stuck with a low GPA, and my parents will kill me... it's always what-ifs in my head, and I just can't seem to sleep or eat because of it.

scenario: Unable to feel rested no matter how much sleep is taken
student_samples: I'm freaking out, okay? My mid-semester exams are just around the corner and I still haven't cracked that one placement paper in my circuits class. I've been studying for hours every day, but somehow, I just can't seem to retain anything.

I'm just so exhausted... like, physically and mentally drained. I feel like I've hit a wall and no matter how much sleep I get, I just can't shake off this tiredness. It's like my brain is foggy, and I'm constantly worried that I'm not good enough for my exams.

scenario: Forgetting to eat because of hyperfocus on assignments
student_samples: Ugh, I'm so exhausted. I've been working on this placement project for days, and I've barely eaten. I was supposed to start my mid-semester exams prep, but all I can think about is this one problem I'm trying to solve.

scenario: Pranayama making anxiety worse instead of better

Our professor announced placement tests for mid-semester and I'm stuck with a super low GPA, it's gonna ruin my chances of getting a good placement, no one's gonna take me if I'm not even a decent student. *takes a shallow breath* My stomach's been growling nonstop for hours, I almost skipped dinner to save some money for the exams, but I couldn't function without eating. This is just perfect, now I'm worrying about food and exams and placements, and my mind is totally blank.

scenario: Feeling like going through the motions without truly living

scenario: Feeling physically exhausted despite sleeping 8 hours

scenario: Skin breakouts causing self-consciousness and avoiding social events

My mind's just filled with dark thoughts - what if I don't get a decent placement? What if I disappoint my parents who've been relying on me for so long? Everyone back in my hostel's been talking about their summer internships and it's just fueling the fire, I feel like I'm stuck in a rut.

My mind is all over the place, I keep thinking about placements and now I'm gonna get rejected or even if I do get a job, it'll be some low-paying internship. And it's all because I wasn't able to keep up with my studies, I thought I was good at this, but apparently, I'm not.

scenario: Unable to concentrate on breath without intrusive thoughts flooding in

scenario: Craving sugar constantly and energy crashing mid-afternoon

Just barely getting by is right – I feel like I'm in survival mode. I'm constantly trying to stay awake in lectures, and then I'll grab a quick energy drink or two, but it only gives me a temporary high. My hostel food can't be helping, it's like they're trying to make us all carb-coma patients.

scenario: Energy completely gone after a heated argument with hostel warden

That's all I need, my mid-semester exam is coming up and now I'll be too stressed out to even study. My friends keep telling me to chill out, but they don't get it. I'll fail my placement if I don't have a good GPA.

scenario: Extreme fatigue crashing after every exam season
student_samples: Ugh, I'm so done with this semester. I just got back my semester marks and I'm not even close to hitting that 75% average to get into good placements. My GPA's gonna take a hit because of all the mid-sem assessments I bombed this time.

*sigh* It's just, all my friends are stressing out about placements and stuff, and I'm already at a disadvantage because of my low marks. I feel like I'm behind everyone else, and no matter how hard I study, I just can't seem to catch up. I'm worried I'll end up with some mediocre job or no job at all after graduation... *shakes head*

scenario: Sleep paralysis episodes causing extreme fear at night

scenario: Tingling in hands and feet during panic that scares the student

scenario: Dragging through the day with zero energy or motivation

scenario: Bright fluorescent lights in exam hall triggering headaches
student_samples: Ugh, I'm dying over here. These fluorescent lights in the exam hall are killing me. My head is pounding, it's like someone's drilling into my brain.

I really need to do well in these exams or I'll ruin my chances of getting a good job after graduation. All this stress is making my photosensitivity way worse, it's like the lights are screaming at me.

scenario: Sudden surge of energy and racing thoughts at 2 AM

My mind just won't shut off, I keep picturing all these worst-case scenarios. What if I don't get into a good company, what if I have to move back home and disappoint my parents? I just feel like my life is spiraling out of control and I need to fix everything right now.

My host sister, Rukmini, just broke up with her boyfriend and she won't stop crying, and my flatmate, Rohan, is stressing about his placement prep and keeps asking for study tips.

scenario: Not exercising for 3 months and feeling the physical decline

scenario: Using phone until 3 AM and feeling groggy all day

Plus, my friends are posting about their mid-sem results, and I'm just... freaking out, I guess.

scenario: Losing the spark that made studying enjoyable earlier
